_comment: Every macro / package-plugin target declared anywhere in the pinned SPM graph, with the git object id of its source tree. Regenerate with scripts/verify-package-trust.sh --update AFTER reading the sources: the diff on this file IS the review record. See FORK-PATCHES.md S6.

components.name: CudaBuild
components.note: Reviewed 2026-09-01 at this revision. Build-tool plugin attached unconditionally to mlx-swift's core Cmlx target, so it cannot be taken out of the graph without forking mlx-swift. Read in full (Plugins/CudaBuild/plugin.swift): createBuildCommands() calls isCudaEnabled(), which is `#if os(Linux) ... #else return false #endif`, so on macOS it prints "CUDA is disabled" and returns an EMPTY command list. It emits no build commands, compiles nothing, and never invokes encuda on this platform. The companion tree Source/Encuda (the executable it would drive on Linux) is hashed too.

components.name: MLXHuggingFaceMacros
components.note: Reviewed 2026-09-01 at this revision. DECLARED in the pinned package but NO LONGER BUILT by this project: it is a dependency only of the MLXHuggingFace target, whose product this fork stopped linking (see VoiceInkRefineXPC/HuggingFaceTokenizerLoader.swift). CI proves it is out of the build graph by NOT passing -skipMacroValidation: were the macro still in the graph, the build would fail with 'Macro "MLXHuggingFaceMacros" ... must be enabled before it can be used' (CI run 33442033271). Source read: SwiftSyntax expression macros emitting adapter shims, no file or network I/O, no process execution.

components.name: GenerateDoccReference
components.note: Reviewed 2026-09-01 at this revision. Apple's own documentation plugin, capability .command: command plugins are never run as part of a build, only when a developer explicitly invokes them, so this never executes in CI. Hash-pinned anyway so a change to it cannot arrive unnoticed.

components.name: GenerateManual
components.note: Reviewed 2026-09-01 at this revision. Apple's own man-page plugin, capability .command; same reasoning as GenerateDoccReference. Never runs during a build.
